description: 한국전자통신연구원_동음이의어 정보 API [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국전자통신연구원. 국립국어원의 표준국어대사전에 등재된 어휘의 동음이의어(소리는 같으나 뜻이 다른 단어) 사전 정보를 조회하는 API로 입력된 어휘의 동음이의어 정보를 제공합니다. 동음이의어 정보 API는 HTTP 기반의 REST API 인터페이스로 JSON 포맷 기반의 입력 및 출력을 지원하며 ETRI에서 제공하는 API... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국전자통신연구원. Its tags are 동음이의어, 표준국어대사전, 어휘, 과학기술. It offers 1 resource(s) in json. The portal shows 2025-07-31 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
